decision.title: searchBooks deprecated upstream in favour of GET /books?q=
decision.question: API 2.0.0 deprecates POST /books/search (Query.lumen_books_searchBooks, D-jnm0uf): 'use GET /books?q= instead', and GET /books gains an optional q parameter (free-text search over title and genre). What should the subgraph do?

choices.label: Add q to lumen_books_books and mark lumen_books_searchBooks @deprecated pointing at it
Add q to lumen_books_books and remove lumen_books_searchBooks now
Keep lumen_books_searchBooks unchanged and do not add q yet
